versions.changelog:
Initial release of Azure语音交互专业版 – enterprise-ready real-time voice AI with advanced API functions.

- Supports real-time function calling (API callouts) in conversational AI.
- Integrates Azure standard, custom, and personal voices.
- Enables telephone audio (G.711, PCM16) support for call center deployment.
- Provides advanced session control: interruption handling and manual/automatic turn-taking.
- Designed for enterprise teams and professional developers, supporting webhook/API/system integration.
